[issue by Luviam]
### Steps to Reproduce the Crash

1. Open a world with the latest version of JER and a version of JEI that is > 19.50.0.414
2. Open the inventory menu and click on a mob drop within the JEI menu.
3. View mobs that drop said item. (You might need to wait a few seconds or click on the GUI)
